functionalReqs: Search restaurants and dishes near the customer
Restaurant accepts and prepares the order
Live tracking of the delivery partner
hints: Model the order as a state machine. Which service owns each transition?
Use a geo index (geohash or quadtree) for nearby restaurants and partners, and a separate store for high-frequency location pings.

Order service with a state machine plus events on Kafka; dispatch service matches orders to partners by distance and ETA; partner locations in Redis GEO; tracking via WebSocket; search via Elasticsearch with geo filters.
nonFunctionalReqs: Order placement must be reliable (no lost or duplicate orders)
Location updates reach the customer within a few seconds
problemStatement:
Design a **food delivery** platform: customers browse nearby restaurants, order, and track the delivery partner live on a map.

The system coordinates three parties (customer, restaurant, delivery partner) through an order lifecycle.

scaleHints.qps: ~2M orders/day; location pings every 4 s ⇒ ~75K writes/s
scaleHints.storage: Orders kept for years; location history short-term

title: Design Zomato / Swiggy (Food Delivery)
